description: Add a note to an entity (lead, contact, company). Common note_type values: "common" for text notes, "call_in"/"call_out" for calls. The params object varies by note_type (e.g., {text: "..."} for common notes).

entity_id.description: Entity ID to add the note to

note_type.description: Note type: common, call_in, call_out, service_message, etc.

params.description: Note parameters. For common notes: {text: "note text"}. For calls: {uniq: "call_id", duration: 60, link: "recording_url", phone: "+1234567890"}
